newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - May 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - May 15.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - Prime Minister Daniel Kablan Duncan says Ivory Coast, currently prey to strike threats and calls by teachers union and others, must strive for social and industrial harmony through dialogue if it is to become a newly industrialised country - West and Central African port experts meet in Abidjan to discuss ways to improve management, port services, security and boosting the role of the private sector LE JOUR - Interior Minister Emile Constant Bombet tells international donor representatives at seminar on decentralisation reforms that Ivory Coast is not a beggar; seminar discusses different ways donors can help - Ivorian rubber company SAPH made after tax profit of five billion CFA francs for financial year ending September 30 1996.
